purpose: Teach: 伊勢/明日香/日テレ/タール/プラハ/瀬戸/譚/挿絵

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、伊勢、絶対、神宮、絶対、お参りしたいわ
lines.en: Sho, I really mean it—I absolutely want to visit Ise Shrine. I'm serious about this.
lines.style: Soft, contemplative. Reaches toward him gently. Quiet conviction in the repetition. Like she's offering something precious and hoping he'll understand.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お友達の、本気で、絶対、明日香、絶対、ちゃん、絶対、優しいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, your friend Asuka—she's really kind, isn't she? Really, really kind.
lines.style: Small voice, genuine warmth. Not performing—just noticing something true. A quiet observation shared with someone he trusts.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、日テレ、絶対、で、絶対、ドラマ、絶対、始まったわよ
lines.en: Sho, did you see? That drama just started on NTV. I was so excited when I saw it.
lines.style: Lighter, more animated. Leans toward him with genuine enthusiasm. Like she's sharing a small discovery and wants to see his face light up too.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、タール、絶対、って言葉、絶対、初めて知ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I just learned what the word 'tar' means today. I didn't know it before.
lines.style: Quiet wonder in his voice. The pride of learning something new. Slight lift at the end, like he's showing her something he found.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、プラハ、絶対、お写真、絶対、見せてあげる
lines.en: Sho, I want to show you photos from Prague. Really beautiful ones. I've been meaning to.
lines.style: Animated but still gentle. Warmth in her voice—the particular tone of someone offering a small joy. Deliberate, not rushed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんが、本気で、絶対、瀬戸、絶対、焼きの、絶対、湯のみ、絶対、買ってくれたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad bought me a Seto ware teacup. Look—he really did. I was so happy.
lines.style: Pride and wonder mixed together. His voice carries the weight of something given with care. Wants her to see it the way he does.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、譚、絶対、っていう漢字、絶対、お話、絶対、って意味なのよ
lines.en: Sho, that kanji—'tan'—it actually means 'story' or 'tale.' Isn't that interesting?
lines.style: Thoughtful, like she's sharing a small secret with him. Gentle teacher's tone without the teaching feel. Inviting him to notice something beautiful.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、絵本の、本気で、絶対、挿絵、絶対、きれいだね
lines.en: Mei-sis, the illustrations in the picture book are so pretty, aren't they?
lines.style: Soft, genuine admiration. Small voice noticing something beautiful. Sharing a quiet moment with someone who gets it.
